$comment: SPDX-License-Identifier: Community-Spec-1.0. FPSOT decisions event data (DEC-072). The data holds identifiers and codes only, never the value of a fact, an amount or a name (DEC-044). The CloudEvents attributes follow API-101.
title: org.fpsot.decisions.review-step.recorded
description: A decision service stored a review step (DEC-062, DEC-072).

reviewStepId.description: The id of the review step, which is also the id of this event (DEC-041).

decisionId.description: The decision record that the service showed the reviewer (DEC-062).

actorId.description: The opaque identifier of the reviewer, as the actor of IAM-091. It is never a name, an email address or a number that identifies a person (IAM-093).

representedPartyId.description: The party that the reviewer acted for (IAM-064).

agreement.description: Whether the reviewer agreed with the result shown (DEC-062).

overrideReason.description: The reason code of a change or a disagreement (DEC-063).
